newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's June forex reserves at $33.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's June forex reserves at $33.3 bln.

text.p: South Korea's foreign exchange reserves rose to $33.3 billion at the end of June from $31.9 billion at the end of May, the central Bank of Korea said on Wednesday.
The central bank said a trade surplus in June and active inflow of foreign funds for equity investment contributed to the increase in foreign exchange holdings.
South Korea's customs-cleared basis trade swung to a surplus of $97.6 million in June from a $613 million deficit in May.

A net of $880 million flowed in June for stock investment, compared with $1.15 billion in May. The inflow was particularly large in May as the foreign stock ownership ceiling was expanded to 23 percent on May 2 from previous 20 percent.
South Korea saw a net outflow in February to April.
